scale.label: How big the armor stand is (one number).

glowColor.label: The color of the armor stand’s glow outline, as a color name.

yaw.label: Turns the element around the vertical axis, in degrees. Prefer rotation, which needs no position updates.

pitch.label: Tilts the element up or down, in degrees.

glowColor.label: The color of the glow outline, as r,g,b. The element glows only while it has the glowing effect.

brightness.label: Fixed light levels for the element instead of the light where it stands.

viewRange.label: How far away players still see the element, as a factor of the normal distance.

shadowRadius.label: The radius of the shadow below the element, in blocks.

lineWidth.label: The width at which the text wraps, in pixels.

backgroundColor.label: The color of the box behind the text.
backgroundColor.help: As a,r,g,b: the first value is the opacity.

textOpacity.label: How opaque the text is, from 0 to 255; -1 is fully opaque.

useDefaultBackgroundColor.label: The text uses the chat’s background color.

alignment.label: How the lines of the text line up.

small.label: The armor stand is the small kind.

sightTrace.label: The model counts for ray tracing (players can look at and hit it).

tints.label: Tints bones of the model with a color from the furniture’s item.

source.label: The component of the furniture’s item the color comes from.

bones.label: The bones to tint; none tints all of them.

children.label: Also tints the children of these bones.

copyData.label: Components the shown item copies from the item the furniture was placed with.
copyData.help: For example minecraft:dyed_color, so dyed furniture shows its color. tint_source is the old name.

conditions.label: Players see the element only while all these conditions hold for them.
conditions.help: Each player is checked on their own, so the element can show for some players and not for others.

tintSource.label: Tints the shown item with a color the block keeps (from a tint or display behavior).
tintSource.help: The components get the color, for example minecraft:dyed_color.

field.label: The components that get the color.

components.label: The components that get the color.

index.label: Which of the block’s colors to use, from 0.

offset.label: Moves the element a little by the block’s coordinates, like vanilla flowers and grass.
offset.help: Read by CraftEngine versions newer than 26.9.

type.label: xz moves the element sideways only, xyz also up and down.

horizontal.label: The largest sideways shift, in blocks.

vertical.label: The largest shift up or down, in blocks.

canUseItemOn.label: Items in hand work on the hitbox, for example to place a block against it.

canBeHitByProjectile.label: Arrows and other projectiles hit the hitbox.

invisible.label: The hitbox has no outline when players look at it.

interactionEntity.label: The shulker gets an interaction entity, so players can click it.

hardCollision.label: Players can stand on the happy ghast and cannot walk through it.

type.label: The kind of entity the hitbox is.

position.label: Where the hitbox stands, in blocks from the furniture’s origin.

width.label: The width of the interaction, in blocks.

height.label: The height of the interaction, in blocks.

scale.label: The size of the entity, as a factor.

peek.label: How far the shulker is open, 0 to 100.

direction.label: The side the shulker opens to.

entityType.label: The vanilla entity the hitbox is, which brings its size.

blocksBuilding.label: Players cannot place blocks inside the hitbox.

hitbox.label: Interaction hitboxes the behavior owns in this variant.

lootSpawnOffset.label: Where the drops appear, in blocks from the furniture’s origin.
lootSpawnOffset.help: Useful for wall and ceiling furniture, whose drops would land inside the block.

blueprint.label: A BetterModel or ModelEngine model bound to the furniture’s own entity.
blueprint.help: One per variant. For more models, add BetterModel or ModelEngine elements.

entityCulling.label: Hides the furniture from players who cannot see it (CraftEngine Premium).
entityCulling.help: On by default. Set per variant, as the wiki shows; CraftEngine 26.9 itself reads it only next to the variants, for all of them (add it there in the additional YAML under furniture:).

field.label: Off turns culling off; on keeps the defaults.

aabb.label: The box that is checked, as x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2; without one CraftEngine works it out.

viewDistance.label: The distance in blocks beyond which the furniture is hidden; -1 for no limit.

aabbExpansion.label: Extra space around the box, in blocks (0.25 by default).

rayTracing.label: Hides the furniture when blocks are in the way.

entityCulling.label: Hides the renderer from players who cannot see it (CraftEngine Premium).
entityCulling.help: On by default; the box covers the block unless you set one.

field.label: Off turns culling off; on keeps the defaults.

aabb.label: The box that is checked, as x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2 from the block’s center; increase it for large models.

viewDistance.label: The distance in blocks beyond which the renderer is hidden; -1 for no limit.

aabbExpansion.label: Extra space around the box, in blocks (0.5 by default).

rayTracing.label: Hides the renderer when blocks are in the way.

sounds.label: The sounds when a player breaks, places or hits the furniture.

adventureModeBreaking.label: Players in adventure mode can break the furniture.

correctTools.label: Only these tools break the furniture.
correctTools.help: Item ids or tags such as #minecraft:axes.

sound.label: A sound id, or an id with volume and pitch.

behaviors.label: What the furniture does besides being placed: store items, show an item, give off light.
behaviors.help: A furniture can have several behaviors, for example two storages, each with its own hitboxes.

light.label: The light sources, the same in every variant.

position.label: Where the light is, in blocks from the furniture’s origin.

level.label: How bright the light is, 1 to 15.

simpleStorageFurniture.label: simple_storage_furniture
simpleStorageFurniture.help: A chest-like storage players open with a right-click.

title.label: The title of the storage window.

rows.label: The rows of the storage, 1 to 6.

dataKey.label: The key the contents are saved under.
dataKey.help: Give each storage of a furniture its own key.

sounds.label: The sounds when the storage opens and closes.

variants.label: The hitboxes that open this storage, per variant. Without any, any hitbox opens it.

displayItemFurniture.label: display_item_furniture
displayItemFurniture.help: Shows an item players put on the furniture. Add the behavior once per slot.

dataKey.label: The key the item is saved under.
dataKey.help: Give each slot of a furniture its own key.

sounds.label: The sounds when a player puts an item on or takes it off.

variants.label: Where the item shows and which hitboxes hold it, per variant.

itemPosition.label: Where the item shows, in blocks from the furniture’s origin.

glowingFurniture.label: glowing_furniture
glowingFurniture.help: Gives off light. Needs furniture.light-system.enable in CraftEngine’s config.yml.

variants.label: Light sources per variant, instead of the same in every variant.
